git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Surgical per-day save.py --day N invocations. No regex. No batch. No migration script. Each numeric edit explicit and accompanied by post-fix invariant printout (15-day total==cat_sum table; 8-route duration matches expected). Fix prevents recurrence by recording actual computed numbers in this report and the spec sections.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: Per-day save.py merge replaces the entire day object inside each agent's days[] array; the merge engine writes the whole day's JSON back even when only a few numeric fields changed. Raw line count overstates the semantic diff. Net semantic delta: 4 numeric writes (Day 3 total + 3 vs_target fields), 3 numeric writes (Day 15 total + 2 vs_target fields), 1 narrative segment swap (Day 3 sentence), 2 narrative segment swaps (Day 5), 8 duration_minutes int writes, 2 prose-prefix swaps (Fangsuo notes_base + notes_local). All under 25 effective lines.
